## How can we leverage sensors in evaluation

Existing literature suggests a link between various physiological signals and operator states such as workload and situational awareness.
With increasing accessability of sensor hardware and compute resources, studies suggest using time-series physiological sensors to quantify such
operator states using sensors such as:

::: {.incremental}
- Eye Trackers
- Heart Rate Monitors
- Electroencephalogram (EEG)
- Functional Near-Infrared Spectroscopy
- Galvanic Skin Response

- Such sensing modalities may allow for new aircraft design considerations and may be useful in evaluating new aircraft as physiological signals
can provide a layer of objective data alongside self assessment techniques
:::
